# Dataset-specific slopes {#sec-slopes}

{{< include _caution.qmd >}}

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
i_am("notebooks/05-dataset-slopes.qmd")  # _quarto.yml would otherwise make notebooks/ the root
library(brms)
library(posterior)

theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 12))
options(mc.cores = 4)

novel_trials <- read_csv(here("data", "derived", "novel_trials.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
```

Teaching varies mostly *between* datasets, and datasets differ in many other ways (procedure,
stimuli, age, lab), so the pooled teaching slope in @sec-exposure-age mixes within- and
between-dataset differences. Here each dataset gets its own teaching slope, age slope and
teaching × age interaction, partially pooled toward the population values. Datasets with no
within-dataset variation in teaching say nothing about their own teaching slope; their estimates
shrink to the population value.

## The model

$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{acc}_{ij} &= (\beta_0 + u_{0d}) + (\beta_1 + u_{1d}) \log(T_{ij} + 1) + (\beta_2 + u_{2d}) \log(\text{age}_i / 24) \\
  &\quad + (\beta_3 + u_{3d}) \log(T_{ij} + 1) \log(\text{age}_i / 24) + v_{\text{child}} + w_{\text{word}} + \epsilon_{ij}
\end{aligned}
$$

The four dataset terms $(u_{0d}, u_{1d}, u_{2d}, u_{3d})$ are correlated (LKJ(2) prior). Other priors
are weakly informative on the accuracy scale:

* fixed effects: Normal(0, 0.2)
* intercept: Normal(0.6, 0.2)
* standard deviations: Exponential(10), mean 0.1
* residual: Exponential(5)

The data are the same as the primary model in @sec-exposure-age: N–N tests, 12–36 months, coded
teaching. Fits are cached in the gitignored `cache/`.

```{r}
#| label: data
nn <- novel_trials |>
  filter(role == "test_nn", age >= 12, age <= 36, !is.na(teaching)) |>
  mutate(log_teaching = log(teaching + 1),
         log_age = log(age / 24),
         position = trial_order / session_trials - .5,
         subject_id = as.character(subject_id))

nn |>
  summarise(n_trials = n(), n_children = n_distinct(subject_id),
            teaching_levels = n_distinct(teaching),
            age_range = paste(round(range(age)), collapse = "–"),
            .by = dataset_name)
```

```{r}
#| label: fit
priors <- c(prior(normal(0.6, 0.2), class = Intercept),
            prior(normal(0, 0.2), class = b),
            prior(exponential(10), class = sd),
            prior(lkj(2), class = cor),
            prior(exponential(5), class = sigma))

m_slopes <- brm(long_window_accuracy ~ log_teaching * log_age +
                  (1 + log_teaching * log_age | dataset_name) +
                  (1 | subject_id) + (1 | target_label),
                data = nn, prior = priors, chains = 4, iter = 3000, warmup = 1000,
                control = list(adapt_delta = .99), seed = 2026,
                file = here("cache", "05_brms_slopes"), file_refit = "on_change")

m_slopes_position <- update(m_slopes, formula. = ~ . + position, newdata = nn, seed = 2026,
                            file = here("cache", "05_brms_slopes_position"),
                            file_refit = "on_change")

fixef_table <- function(fit) as_tibble(fixef(fit), rownames = "term")

bind_rows(slopes = fixef_table(m_slopes),
          slopes_plus_position = fixef_table(m_slopes_position), .id = "model") |>
  filter(term != "Intercept")
```

```{r}
#| label: diagnostics
summarise_draws(m_slopes, "rhat", "ess_bulk") |>
  summarise(max_rhat = max(rhat, na.rm = TRUE), min_ess_bulk = min(ess_bulk, na.rm = TRUE))
nuts_params(m_slopes) |> filter(Parameter == "divergent__") |> summarise(divergences = sum(Value))
```

## The teaching effect across age

The slope of accuracy on log(teaching + 1) at a given age is
$\beta_1 + \beta_3 \log(\text{age}/24)$: the change in accuracy per unit of log exposures, or
about 0.69 times that per doubling.

```{r}
#| label: fig-slope-by-age
#| fig-cap: "Teaching slope (change in accuracy per unit log(teaching + 1)) as a function of age: population estimate (line) with 50% and 95% credible bands, from the dataset-slopes model. Points are each dataset's own slope at its median age (95% CrI); filled points are datasets whose teaching range spans at least one exposure; open points (no real within-dataset variation) are shrunk to the population value."
draws <- as_draws_df(m_slopes)

slope_by_age <- tibble(age = seq(12, 36, by = .5)) |>
  mutate(slope = map(age, \(a) draws$b_log_teaching + draws$`b_log_teaching:log_age` * log(a / 24))) |>
  mutate(est = map_dbl(slope, median),
         lo95 = map_dbl(slope, quantile, .025), hi95 = map_dbl(slope, quantile, .975),
         lo50 = map_dbl(slope, quantile, .25), hi50 = map_dbl(slope, quantile, .75))

dataset_info <- nn |>
  summarise(age = median(age), varies = max(teaching) - min(teaching) >= 1, .by = dataset_name)

dataset_slopes <- dataset_info |>
  mutate(slope = map2(dataset_name, age, \(d, a) {
    r1 <- draws[[paste0("r_dataset_name[", d, ",log_teaching]")]]
    r3 <- draws[[paste0("r_dataset_name[", d, ",log_teaching:log_age]")]]
    (draws$b_log_teaching + r1) + (draws$`b_log_teaching:log_age` + r3) * log(a / 24)
  }),
  est = map_dbl(slope, median),
  lo = map_dbl(slope, quantile, .025), hi = map_dbl(slope, quantile, .975)) |>
  select(-slope)

ggplot(slope_by_age, aes(x = age)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo95, ymax = hi95), alpha = .15) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo50, ymax = hi50), alpha = .25) +
  geom_line(aes(y = est), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_pointrange(data = dataset_slopes, aes(y = est, ymin = lo, ymax = hi, shape = varies),
                  position = position_jitter(width = .4, height = 0, seed = 1)) +
  geom_text(data = dataset_slopes, aes(y = hi, label = dataset_name), size = 2.6, vjust = -.6,
            position = position_jitter(width = .4, height = 0, seed = 1)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 16, `FALSE` = 1),
                     labels = c(`TRUE` = "varies teaching", `FALSE` = "one teaching level")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(9, 38), breaks = seq(12, 36, 6)) +
  labs(x = "Age (months)", y = "Teaching slope", shape = "Dataset")
```

```{r}
#| label: slope-table
dataset_slopes |> arrange(age)
```

## Predicted accuracy

Population-level predictions (dataset, child and word effects set to zero) at representative
ages, each over the teaching range observed within 3 months of that age. Points are child means in
the matching age bins, with no lines between them.

```{r}
#| label: fig-pred-age
#| fig-cap: "Predicted accuracy by teaching exposures at four ages (lines, 95% credible bands) from the dataset-slopes model, with observed child means (points; size = number of children) in the age bins centred on those ages. Dashed line is chance."
ages <- tibble(age = c(15, 21, 27, 33), age_bin = c("12–18", "18–24", "24–30", "30–36"))

grid <- ages |>
  mutate(teaching = map(age, \(a) {
    obs <- nn$teaching[abs(nn$age - a) <= 3]
    seq(min(obs), max(obs), length.out = 40)
  })) |>
  unnest(teaching) |>
  mutate(log_teaching = log(teaching + 1), log_age = log(age / 24))

pred <- bind_cols(grid, as_tibble(fitted(m_slopes, newdata = grid, re_formula = NA)))

points <- nn |>
  mutate(age_bin = cut(age, c(12, 18, 24, 30, 36.01), right = FALSE,
                       labels = ages$age_bin)) |>
  summarise(acc = mean(long_window_accuracy), .by = c(age_bin, teaching, subject_id)) |>
  summarise(mean = mean(acc), n = n(), .by = c(age_bin, teaching)) |>
  filter(n >= 5)

ggplot(pred, aes(x = teaching + 1, colour = age_bin, fill = age_bin)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = .5, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Q2.5, ymax = Q97.5), alpha = .12, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Estimate), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = points, aes(y = mean, size = n), alpha = .6) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(1, 2, 3, 5, 9, 17), labels = \(x) x - 1) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d(end = .9, aesthetics = c("colour", "fill")) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 5) +
  labs(x = "Teaching exposures before test (log scale)", y = "Proportion target looking",
       colour = "Age (months)", fill = "Age (months)", size = "Children")
```

Within each dataset: the dataset's own predicted curve (including its random effects) at its median
age, over its observed teaching range, against its child means by teaching level.

```{r}
#| label: fig-pred-dataset
#| fig-cap: "Dataset-specific predictions (line, 95% credible band) at each dataset's median age, with observed child means by teaching level (points, ±95% CI). Datasets with a single teaching level show only a point."
#| fig-height: 6
grid_ds <- nn |>
  summarise(age = median(age), lo = min(teaching), hi = max(teaching), .by = dataset_name) |>
  mutate(teaching = map2(lo, hi, \(l, h) seq(l, h, length.out = 30))) |>
  unnest(teaching) |>
  mutate(log_teaching = log(teaching + 1), log_age = log(age / 24))

pred_ds <- bind_cols(grid_ds, as_tibble(fitted(m_slopes, newdata = grid_ds,
                                               re_formula = ~ (1 + log_teaching * log_age | dataset_name))))

points_ds <- nn |>
  summarise(acc = mean(long_window_accuracy), .by = c(dataset_name, teaching, subject_id)) |>
  summarise(mean = mean(acc), n = n(), ci = 1.96 * sd(acc) / sqrt(n),
            .by = c(dataset_name, teaching)) |>
  filter(n >= 5)

ggplot(pred_ds, aes(x = teaching + 1)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = .5, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Q2.5, ymax = Q97.5), alpha = .15) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Estimate), linewidth = .9) +
  geom_pointrange(data = points_ds, aes(y = mean, ymin = mean - ci, ymax = mean + ci),
                  size = .3, colour = "grey30") +
  facet_wrap(~dataset_name) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(1, 2, 3, 5, 9, 17), labels = \(x) x - 1) +
  labs(x = "Teaching exposures before test (log scale)", y = "Proportion target looking")
```
